versions.title: Enclosed liner duct
versions.summary: Body-fixed passage → free jet toward the inner rotor region.
versions.decision: V1 practical packaging model complete: Corolla-specific mounting, shorter directed outlet, and approximate steering checked. Physical fit and cooling performance remain unverified.

versions.title: Arm scoop / body shroud
versions.summary: V2A arm-mounted open scoop; V2B body-fixed turning shroud.
versions.decision: Arm scoop and body shroud r1: one-piece guides with their discharge aimed up and outboard toward the rotor vane entrance; mounting fixings inferred. Donor fit and performance are not transferred.

versions.title: Hose-fed rotor receiver
versions.summary: Liner transition → flexible hose → close rotor-vent receiver.
versions.decision: Prioritise rotor ventilation entry. Retain the OEM structural bracket and design a separate nonstructural carrier.

versions.title: Rotor + caliper cooling
versions.summary: Rotor feed plus a deliberate pad/caliper path and removable shell.
versions.decision: Design around our OEM ADVICS four-piston front caliper. Preserve rotor delivery and give the removable caliper branch a real target and exit. No direct-fit OEM hood verified in this search.
